intended_behavior: Modify the __init__ method to accept an i18n instance as a parameter and assign it to self._i18n instead of always creating a new I18N(). This ensures that ToolUsage shares the localization settings with the agent, allowing custom prompt_file messages to be used.

When creating a ToolUsage instance, pass the agent’s i18n instance to ToolUsage. This ensures that the ToolUsage uses the same i18n instance as the agent, maintaining localization consistency across the system.
